text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш greets her second summer
camp with
coolness and poise.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We don't have much longer before the
autumn
Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Let's tackle this summer camp as if it's
the last
opportunity to prepare myself
for it.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Once I've done what I need to do, I'm
setting my
sights on retirement.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
This could be my last summer camp with
Eishin
Flash...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'd better etch the image of her racing
down the
track into my memory. There
might not be many
more chances.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
